properties.name: release.server.host
properties.description: 发布模式回调服务器主机名或基址，为空时不发起服务器回调。Ex: http://www.xuesinuo.com

properties.name: release.server.prefix
properties.description: 服务器提供接口的统一前缀，会拼接到 /muppet/* 路径前。Ex: /muppet

properties.name: release.server.token
properties.description: 发布模式回调鉴权令牌，通过请求头 Muppet-Token 发送。Ex: xuesinuo

properties.name: release.signin.enable
properties.description: 是否开启打印机注册功能。true 开启后在桌面界面显示注册相关按钮。Ex: true
